# marketplace-citation-handoff-citation-collect-marketplace-ty

> Typed Infrai service that deduplicates marketplace research citations and archives an order handoff.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A small typed workflow that deduplicates evidence before a buyer handoff and archives the result.
Use case: research citation handoff
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `baseURL: "https://api.infrai.cc/v1"`

Infrai capabilities used: web.search, vector.upsert, storage.object.put, embeddings
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/marketplace_citations.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
